name: Futakoi Alternative: Koi to Shoujo to Machinegun
original_name: フタコイオルタナティブ　恋と少女とマシンガン
source:
Futakoi Alternative tells the story of Futaba Rentarou and his detective agency. One day a set of twins, [url=/c19021]Shirogane Sara[/url] and [url=/c19022]Shirogane Souju[/url], show up at his doorstep. They move in with him and work as secretaries for his agency.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Futakoi_Alternative#Story]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《双恋Alternative》讲述双叶恋太郎与其侦探事务所的故事。一天，一对双胞胎[url=/c19021]白钟沙罗[/url]和[url=/c19022]白钟双树[/url]来到他家门前。她们搬来与他同住，并在事务所担任秘书。

[编辑自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Futakoi_Alternative#Story]Wikipedia[/url]]
